# gcovr and its dependencies for rrf-harness.yml, installed with pip install --only-binary :all: --require-hashes -r <this file>
#
# Each hash is the sha256 of the one wheel that pip 24.0 picks on the ubuntu-24.04 runner: Python 3.12.3, glibc 2.39, x86_64,
# as the runner image lists them (actions/runner-images, images/ubuntu/Ubuntu2404-Readme.md, image 20261101.360.1).
# Source: the PyPI JSON API, https://pypi.org/pypi/<project>/<version>/json, urls[].digests.sha256 of the file named above
# each requirement. On 2026-11-08 every hash was also checked against sha256sum of that wheel, downloaded with pip download
# by the same Python, glibc and pip. Another Python picks other wheels of lxml and MarkupSafe and fails the hash check

# gcovr-8.6-py3-none-any.whl
gcovr==8.6 \
    --hash=sha256:dbf9d87c38042752ad6f530aa8210427e22b526611bb7b7bfed0e81977d1f1ef
# colorlog-6.12.0-py3-none-any.whl
colorlog==6.12.0 \
    --hash=sha256:30d392604e9110045a2c2aeefc27d7a017abbab63f3a8aee594eac0801df784e

Jinja2==3.1.6 \
    --hash=sha256:85ece4451f492d0c13c5dd7c13a64681a86afae63a5f347908daf103ce6d2f67
# lxml-6.1.3-cp312-cp312-manylinux_2_26_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl
lxml==6.1.3 \
    --hash=sha256:909f4e927bb051f7740d6367285fc60cdcfdaf0258c2dba4ff5ba7eadadc250c
